english: Only one can enter. I'll wait... Huh? Sougo's gone again.
I'm entering the battle!
Oh, it's you... That Shinsengumi guy...
You again too, huh...
Oh, it's you again... From back then...
Still sound like small fry. Let's get started!
I win. Predictable outcome.
A superb Gin Tama? What's that?
Beat seven to win, right? Beat you, so six left.
I win. Five more and this underground champion shows up, right?
Damn...
Got careless...
But what?
What?! Such brutal game balance!
Oh. Small Fry Number Two.
Natural result.
Who's third?!
Small fry... Got careless...
What?! Such brutal game balance!
Yes! Even small fry can beat the hero if they live right!
Fine. Don't want to, but I'll fight you.
Three down.
Number four! Get out here!
No way...!
So pissed off. Wanna stuff myself to death with mayo curry rice!
What?! Such brutal game balance!
Failed as a main character! Come back if you're sore about it! ...But!
Now here's a guy whose place in the cast is... pretty iffy.
...Can't have a normal conversation with him. Let's end this!
Four down!
...I'll arrest you someday. Next!
I slipped up...!
...Hm? You're... Shinsengumi, right...?
Shut up! My life's none of your business!
Huh?! ...You're...!
Hopeless. You bite at anything...
That's why the Yorozuya toy with you!
Take my advice. Know your place and live humbly. Lose the shades.
Hah! Words won't work? I'll beat it into you!
Let's go!
Ahh... My turn...\n...Wait, it's YOU again!
MY line. After all I said, you're STILL doing this?
...Honestly. Shameless to the core.
No holding back now. Let's go!
Leave me alone! Don't meddle in my lifestyle!
Shut up! I'll show you someday! Just you wait!
...Five down! Get number six out here!
...Escape reality all you want. Anyway, you're done.
Lose and it's game over.
Yeah. Didn't tell you.
T-this is a mistake! I couldn't lose to HIM...!\f...Right! A dream! Must be a nightmare!
Done...? What's that mean?
What?! Nobody told me!
Damn! Such brutal game balance!
Yorozuya's China girl?! Why are you here?!
Just happened...?
...Tch. Now THIS just happened. If we're fighting, I'm not holding back!
Huh? You're Shinsengumi...?!
Either way, I ate the kelp already. Dine-and-dash is wrong.
...That Yorozuya's raising her all wrong.
Huh? You again?
Heaven put kelp above man! Fight me, mayo freak!
Is your head full of NOTHING but kelp?!
...Then go home and eat! Six down!\fGet out the last one! This underground champion!
Damn... Didn't know she was so strong!
...Then go home and eat!\nThat's six down!
What's with this brutal game balance?!
Will do. I eat dinner. You get game over!
...?! H-hey! You're Sougo!
What are you doing here?! And why are YOU the champion?!
You're just making it up as you go!
Saves you WHAT trouble?!
Let's go, idiot Sougo!
Oh, it's... Hijikata.
Small world.
Could put it that way. So... Battle or quit?
...Anyway, shall we start? No hard feelings.
...?! YOU again, Sougo?!
Still playing champion here?!
Don't get smart! Let's go, Sougo!
Oh, it's you again, Hijikata.
Coincidences keep coming.
Felt like it... Good benefits here. Considering a career change.
Want a fight? Won't hold back, even against you, Hijikata.
Honestly! What a bastard!
Hmm... Looks like ordinary Gin Tama.\fI'll try it someday if I get the chance. Oh, and...
I'll let it slide today... Get too flashy and I'll arrest you someday!
See ya, then!
Huh? Arrest?! ...Wait, are you... the police...?!
Ahh, lost. You're strong, Hijikata!
Of course. Kondo worries too much.
You! Sougo!
Don't laugh! Turning on me out of nowhere! You absolute idiot!
You're living all wrong! I'll make you see that someday!
Oh! Toshi! You're safe!
Hey, Toshi!\nWait! Don't leave me!
Welcome back. Haha...
What a short fuse. Needs more calcium...
Damn! How could I lose to that empty-headed Sougo...?!
After a while? What's that mean, Sougo?
YOU'RE the cruelest one!
Looks like I win.
Luck of the draw... Let's say you were unlucky this time.
So try again later... After a little while.
...Game over. My condolences...
Blame this cruel world, if you must.
Why?
What does that mean?
Not what you said! Mocking me, bastard?
What?! Hah! In for a penny, in for a pound!\fOne challenger? I'll take any number!
Come on, late entrant! Get out here!
You?! ...Takasugi! Shinsuke Takasugi!
Takasugi... Just showing up like this? Think you'll leave in one piece?
...Fine. First, I'll beat you in a Gin Tama battle...
Then I'll tie you up!
Hmph. Do your best.
...Been a while.
S-Shinsuke Takasugi! Still hanging around here...?!
What the hell are you thinking?
Keep talking... Let's go!
...Meet again, shogunate dog.
Heh... Can a shogunate lapdog manage that...?
You lose, Takasugi.
Better than a stray that can only bite and spout selfish excuses.
Wait! Like hell I'll just let you go!
Quiet! I'm in a bad mood! Hand over the prize!
...I'll try it someday, if I get the chance. Oh, and...
...Impressive. Good skills.\fAlmost too good for a shogunate dog.
Big words... Well, that was fun. See ya, shogunate dog...
Hahahaha! See ya!
...Heh. Looking forward to it.
...Refuse and I cut you down!
What?! What does that mean?
What?! Such brutally unfair game balance!
Hmph... Sloppy.\fNo cause, no ideals. Just a shogunate lapdog. Fitting end.\fDisappointing. ...Farewell, lapdog.
Heh... Pathetic. ...Game over.
What's this?
I can SEE that...\fWas this here before?
Wrong manga!
Could it LOOK more like a knockoff?!
I see. Bring all seven Dragon Tama here, then.
Something written here.
Dragon Tama?! No! What a waste!
Or what? Is this Shenron?
What...?\fSo this dragon is the Dragon Tama god?!
Right!\fWait here! I'll gather every Dragon Tama and bring them!
A dragon...
Dunno... Probably buried under the scrap.
Close, Kondo.
...\fName aside, it's clearly linked to Dragon Tama...\fHijikata... Maybe this dragon grants wishes...
Don't know if it's a god, though...
Wait here! I'll gather every Dragon Tama and bring them!
What, Kondo? The Dragon Tama god you've been waiting for!
What is it? A dragon, obviously.
Cut.
Is it that scary?
Well... Time to meet Shenron...
S-something's scary about this, Toshi...
Maybe... We woke something that should've stayed asleep...?
D-\fDEATH NOOOTE!!
SCARYYYYY!
Don't cut it! That's not what I...!
I-\fIT'S HERE!
R-really taking wishes?\fSo sudden... What do I do...?
What?!
You didn't even SEE it!
Kondo. Save that story for later... Come on, Sougo.
What?! Toshi! What did you wish for?!
Hey! No fair, Toshi! WAIT!
Your wish is granted...\fI return to sleep. If you have courage, gather the Dragon Tama again...\fFarewell...
...\fWell, that was something.
Hijikata muttered a wish.
...\fDragon Tama collecting's over, then...\fWhat a relief...
Hot! My Gin Tama are burning up!
Sorry. Can't be bothered, so we're closed today.
W... oof...
Ahh... So tired...
Oedo's scary...\fCan't survive in this concrete jungle!
I've got a dream to become a dancer. Won't give up that easily.\fBut... Bought another expensive vase yesterday...
Running's a strategy too!
Quick on your feet, huh. Fine. Come back and you're dead.
Hey! Are you even the main character?!
Hm? Oh! Th-this is...!
DRAGON TAMA GET!
Hm? What's this? A Dragon Tama?
Funny how nobody notices. Guess I'll take it...
Nothing suspicious here...
Looks like there's nothing here.
translator_note: Gintoki inspects an empty spot near the opening.

english: Nothing that stands out...
Nothing here...?
Why am I searching here?
All clear... Try somewhere else...
Huh? Out of gas?! Damn it!
Tch... Phone won't connect...
Save cleared-game data?
Oh! Gin Tama GET!
Huh? Isn't this mine? Really? Oh, thank goodness! Found my orb!
Well, well. Gin Tama here!
Someone drop Gin Tama? I'll hold onto it.
...This one's mine.
